No schema change, no db push, no commit or push by a bundle. New env variables are listed in plan section 4; PAR-10 documents them.

Job sources, prices and rails follow docs/jobright-clone/market/MARKET_STRATEGY.md (D6). Plan section 9 lists its requirements that are folded into these bundles (JC-1, JC-2 interim, JC-4, JC-7, the linkedin line of JI-2, AL-1, AL-2, AL-5, PC-1 GoApply half, PC-2) and those left to its own waves, which start after this wave because they touch files owned by PAR-6, PAR-7 and PAR-11.

Critic pass (2026-10-11, plan section 10): the former PAR-7 is split into PAR-7 (sources and ingest, admin sources) and PAR-11 (feed and job-detail contract, default-on tests, detail and import guards). Two facts measured that day change the job-source items: (a) https://www.gohire.top/jobs/<id> and https://www.robohire.io/jobs/<id> render the sites' Page-not-found page, so a recruiter-bank row has no working apply link until its bank has a candidate-facing posting page (PAR-7 item 3); (b) 27 public employer boards answered through the documented board APIs with 1,828 postings located in mainland China (PAR-7 item 4), which is the source that makes the GoApply feed non-empty in this wave.

PAR-1 is implemented (worktree wp-PAR-1, handoff docs/jobright-clone/orch/handoffs-par/PAR-1.md). Its handoff lists 95 red tests by owning bundle and requests P2-1..P10-1; every one is assigned in the items below (the four files it found in no bundle's owns now belong to PAR-2 and PAR-11). Each bundle reads its section of that handoff first. Deployment rule from that handoff (O-1): do not deploy between the PAR-1 merge and the PAR-2 and PAR-5 merges, or set ALLOWED_BRANDS=roboapply on the RoboApply production deployment until the wave is merged.

[P0] GoHire bank over HTTPS when its database endpoint cannot satisfy the TLS rule (G83, G84, G85; MARKET_STRATEGY JC-2 interim)
CHANGE: keep bankTlsSatisfied as it is. server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/bank.ts: add readBankPageViaApi behind the existing BankPageReader seam (189-208). The list endpoint is GET <GOHIRE_API_BASE>/api/v1/jobs with GOHIRE_API_KEY (read in the GoHire backend source on 2026-10-11: status, sortBy, sortDir, page, limit <= 50; the response rows carry every Job column). Call it with status=open&sortBy=aging&limit=50&page=N: 'aging' orders published rows first (publishedAt ascending, nulls last), so the reader stops at the first row whose publishedAt is null and never pages through unpublished requisitions (about 4 calls for the ~180 published rows of 1,273 open ones, not 26). 20 s timeout, one call per page, at most 40 pages per pass. A strict in-memory whitelist equal to BANK_SYNC_SELECT plus education and headcount is applied to every row before anything is logged or stored; no other field of the response (notes, evaluationRules, passingScore, aiInsights, clientKey, organizationId ...) reaches a log line, an error message or a column. The list rows carry companyName but not the company relation: map with company null. The cursor of this transport is its own (pass start time and page number in params.cursor), not the updatedAt|id cursor of the database reader. Closure: the list returns only open rows, so a closed job disappears instead of arriving with a closed status. After a complete pass (stop condition reached, no error) the adapter reports the full id list of the pass and the pipeline archives the open gohire rows of market cn that are not in it, with closeReason bank_closed (the listing diff the employer boards already use, atsPublic/sync.ts closedExternalIds); a pass that failed or was cut short closes nothing. When GOHIRE_SYNDICATION_URL is set use that endpoint instead (cursor on updatedAt and id, tombstones archive the row). Transport = GOHIRE_BANK_TRANSPORT (db | api | off); default db when the URL satisfies TLS, else api when the key is set. isSyncableBankJob and the named-employer requirement are unchanged; skip and count bank_unpublished, bank_no_company and bank_test_posting (empty company, or a title containing 测试); label rows as agency postings (代招) unless the bank states the employer is verified; only then may a row carry 企业直招. server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raBankClients.ts isBankEnabled reports the api transport, and the live cross-bank search (RACrossBankSearchService) reads the synced RAJob mirror when no database client exists.
ACCEPT: with the current env (non-TLS database URL, API key present) the gohire adapter is enabled over HTTPS and a pass reads only the published pages; a response row carrying notes or evaluationRules never reaches a log line or a column; a row missing from a complete pass is archived as bank_closed and a failed pass archives nothing; with a stub syndication server a cursor sync upserts rows and a tombstone archives one; the database transport path is untouched. Whether a synced row is listed is decided by the next item.
TESTS: ingest/adapters/adapters.test.ts with a mocked fetch (whitelist, stop at the first unpublished row, page cap, skip tallies, timeout, listing diff after a complete pass, no diff after a failed pass, tombstone), server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raBankProviders.test.ts, RACrossBankSearchService.test.ts.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/bank.ts, pipeline.ts, upsert.ts, server/src/features/jobs/sources/types.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raBankClients.ts, raBankProviders.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/services/RACrossBankSearchService.ts

[P0] A recruiter-bank row is listed only when its bank has a candidate-facing posting page (critic finding, measured 2026-10-11; D3; plan 3.9)
CHANGE: synthesizeApplyUrl (server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raCrossBankMatch.ts:645-651) builds <base>/jobs/<id> with the defaults https://www.gohire.top and https://www.robohire.io. Neither site has that route: both render their Page-not-found page for /jobs/<any id> (opened in a browser on 2026-10-11; the GoHire / RoboHire frontend router has only the signed-in recruiter route /product/jobs/:id and a catch-all NotFound, and vercel.json rewrites every path to the app shell, so the HTTP status is 200 and a status check proves nothing). Every bank row therefore carries an apply link that leads nowhere, on both brands. Replace the defaults with one explicit template per bank: GOHIRE_PUBLIC_JOB_URL_TEMPLATE and ROBOHIRE_PUBLIC_JOB_URL_TEMPLATE (https, must contain {id}); add bankPublicJobUrl(bank, id, env) and make synthesizeApplyUrl return null when the bank's template is unset. The old GOHIRE_PUBLIC_JOB_BASE_URL / ROBOHIRE_PUBLIC_JOB_BASE_URL are ignored with one startup warning that names the new variable (they pointed at the missing route). With no template the bank adapter does not emit the row as a job: it counts it as bank_no_public_page and returns its id for closure with a new SourceCloseReason 'no_apply_target' (server/src/features/jobs/sources/types.ts; add it to the revive list in ingest/upsert.ts:361-363 so rows return on the first sync after the template is set). The legacy materialiser (raCrossBankMatch.ts:661-700) skips a candidate with no apply URL. The rule is one code path for both banks, so it also takes RoboApply's RoboHire-bank rows (about 70 in the dev database) out of its feed until RoboHire has such a page: a deliberate RoboApply change (plan principle P7 exception) because a dead apply link is not a usable apply URL. Do not build an apply page, an application form or any submission in RoboApply (D1); the page belongs to the bank's own product (owner item 6 of plan section 8, second repository).
ACCEPT: with neither template set no bank row is listed on either brand, the admin sources panel shows the synced count and the reason bank_no_public_page, and the GoApply feed is served by the employer boards; with GOHIRE_PUBLIC_JOB_URL_TEMPLATE=https://example.test/p/{id} a synced GoHire row is listed with that apply URL and apply.target gohire, and rows archived as no_apply_target come back; no market cn row without an apply URL reaches the feed, similar jobs, alerts or Ready to apply (ingest/pipeline.ts:125-128 stays for every market).
TESTS: server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raCrossBankMatch.test.ts (template and null cases), ingest/adapters/adapters.test.ts (bank_no_public_page tally, closure reason, revive), ingest/pipeline.test.ts (a market cn row without an apply URL is never written).
FILES: server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raCrossBankMatch.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/bank.ts, pipeline.ts, upsert.ts, server/src/features/jobs/sources/types.ts

[P0] Employer boards: postings located in mainland China enter the GoApply index (G93; MARKET_STRATEGY JC-4). This is the source that fills the GoApply feed in this wave
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/adapter.ts: markets intl and cn; fetch reads dueCareerSources for query.market. A posting's market comes from its own resolved location, for every source: country CN -> cn, anything else -> intl, each row in exactly one market (MARKET_STRATEGY JC-4). A run writes only the rows of its own market and skips the rest with note wrong_market, so a cn source keeps its mainland postings and an intl source no longer writes a mainland posting into RoboApply's index. A board is read by the market on its source row in this wave: RACareerSiteSource is unique on (ats, boardToken) with one market column and one lastSyncedAt, and there is no schema change here. One board feeding several countries or both brands (RACareerSiteSource.countries, the #cn copy of a posting with locations in both markets) is the market wave's part of JC-4; put it in the handoff as a schema request, do not approximate it. The mainland filter runs on the listing BEFORE the per-board input cap (connectors.ts prioritise / MAX_POSTINGS_PER_BOARD = 500): without that, a global board's few mainland postings can sit outside the cap on every run and never be stored, because skipped rows always look new. SmartRecruiters: for a cn source add country=cn to the listing call (a documented filter of the Posting API; it returned 1,322 postings for BoschGroup on 2026-10-11) and page the listing to the end (cap 3,000 ids) so the listing is complete and closures work; posting texts stay capped at SR_MAX_DETAILS per run and fill in over runs. Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby return the whole board in one listing: filter by the listing's own location fields. service.ts:113-119,162,188 and routes.ts:27-44: a GoApply admin can list, add and check sources (body.market cn accepted; standing-query lookup and the enqueue brand follow row.market instead of the hard-coded intl / roboapply). Add server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/seeds.cn.json and a loader that registers the seed boards once with market cn and countryCode CN; companyName comes from the board's own metadata, never typed from memory. Candidate list, measured on 2026-10-11 through the same public endpoints the connectors call, as mainland postings per board (ats token count): smartrecruiters BoschGroup 1,322; smartrecruiters AbbVie 149; lever veeva 54; smartrecruiters WesternDigital 45; greenhouse riotgames 39; ashby airwallex 37; greenhouse flexport 25; smartrecruiters Continental 24; smartrecruiters NielsenIQ 20; greenhouse payoneer 19; smartrecruiters Wabtec 16; greenhouse coupang 13; smartrecruiters Ubisoft2 13; smartrecruiters Eurofins 10; greenhouse scopely 7; smartrecruiters Canva 6; greenhouse mongodb 5; greenhouse agoda 5; greenhouse adyen 3; lever animocabrands 3; greenhouse moloco 2; greenhouse applovin 2; greenhouse airbnb 2; greenhouse databricks 2; greenhouse epicgames 2; lever weride 2; greenhouse appier 1. That is 27 boards and 1,828 postings; the counts used a location text match, so re-check each board through the connector in the session and seed only boards where the documented API answers 200 and at least one posting resolves to mainland China; record the measured count per board in the handoff and list any candidate that failed. Do not add a board from memory. No connector for a Chinese ATS vendor's internal endpoint and no career-site HTML (no-scraping rule). No posting-age cut-off: a board row closes when the board stops listing it. Rewrite adapter.ts:13-15 and service.ts:5.
ACCEPT: a Greenhouse fixture posting in 上海 from a cn source lands in market cn with the employer's own apply URL; a Singapore posting from the same source is skipped as wrong_market, and a 上海 posting read through an intl source is skipped the same way (never written to RoboApply's index); a fixture board of 800 postings with 5 mainland ones stores all 5 in one run; a SmartRecruiters cn source lists with country=cn and reports a complete listing; after a sync of the seed file on the clone dev stack RAJob has at least 300 public market cn rows with sourceBoard in the four ATS names across at least 10 boards (fewer is a failed acceptance to report with the per-board counts, not something to pad).
TESTS: atsPublic/atsPublic.test.ts, routes.test.ts, connectors tests (filter before cap, country filter, listing cap), a seed-file shape test (unique tokens, known ATS types).

[P1] Mainland normalisation: education, employment type, pay as posted, bank 学历 and headcount (G86, G92; MARKET_STRATEGY JC-7)
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/normalize/level.ts: add educationFromText (不限学历, 大专/专科及以上, 本科及以上, 硕士及以上, 博士, 统招) returning a level and the evidence quote; call it in normalizeProviderJob.ts when the provider gives none (fieldSources.educationLevel 'posting_text'). Pay: '1.5-2.5万' reads as 15,000-25,000 monthly, 'K·N薪' keeps its months and is shown as posted, a bare number with no unit is not filterable, and no pay text means salary null (never 面议 unless the posting says it).
